043package dev.visdb.seesaw.formatting;
044
045import java.lang.System.Logger;
046import java.lang.System.Logger.Level;
047import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
048
049import javax.swing.text.DateFormatter;
050import javax.swing.text.DefaultFormatterFactory;
051
052import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff;
053
054import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
055
056/**
057 * Used to link a SsTimestampField to a timestamp column in a database.
058 */
059@SuppressWarnings("serial")
060public class SsTimestampField extends DateTimeField {
061  /** Logger for component */
062  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
063
064  /**
065   * Create an SSTimestampField using the default format.
066   */
067  public SsTimestampField() {
068    this(SsFormat.TIMESTAMP);
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Create an SSTimestampField using the specified format.
073   *  @param format - an enum format for the timestamp field
074   */
075  public SsTimestampField(SsFormat format) {
076    this(createFormatterFactory(format));
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Creates an instance of SSTimestampField with the specified formatter factory
081   * @param factory - formatter factory to be used
082   */
083  public SsTimestampField(AbstractFormatterFactory factory) {
084    super(factory);
085    setValue(new java.util.Date());
086  }
087
088  /**
089   * Sets the value of the field to the current system date/time
090   */
091  @Override
092  public void cleanField() {
093    setValue(new java.util.Date());
094  }
095
096  /**
097   * Create TIMESTAMP formatter factory with specified format pattern.
098   * @param _format - Format to use for timestamp while in editing mode.
099   * @return a DefaultFormatterFactory for the specified time format
100   */
101  public static DefaultFormatterFactory createFormatterFactory(SsFormat _format) {
102    SsFormat format = _format;
103    if (_format.getType() != SsFormat.TIMESTAMP) {
104      logger.log(Level.ERROR, () -> sf("%s is not a TIMESTAMP, using default", _format.toString()));
105      format = SsFormat.TIMESTAMP;
106    }
107    format = SsFormat.getActualFormat(format);
108    String formatMask;
109    String editPattern;
110    switch (format) {
111      case TIMESTAMP_YYYYMMDD_STROKE_HHMMSS_SSSZ -> {
112        formatMask = "####-##-## ##:##:##.### *##:##";
113        // TODO: try "xxx" not "Z".
114        editPattern = "yyyyMMddHHmmssSSSZ";
115      }
116      case TIMESTAMP_YYYYMMDD_STROKE_HHMMSS -> {
117        formatMask = "####-##-## ##:##:##";
118        editPattern = "yyyyMMddHHmmss";
119      }
120      case TIMESTAMP_YYYYMMDD_STROKE -> {
121        formatMask = "####-##-##";
122        editPattern = "yyyyMMdd";
123      }
124      default -> {
125        logger.log(Level.ERROR, "Unknown date format type of " + format);
126        return null;
127      }
128    }
129    return new MaskFormatterFactory.Builder<>(formatMask)
130        .ssFormat(format)
131        .stringValidator(DateTimeField::stringValidator)
132        .converter(new DateFormatter(new SimpleDateFormat(editPattern)))
133        .placeholderCharacter('_')
134        .build();
135  }
136}
